strong_auxiliary_support.rule: At least 80% of at least five valid eligible Auxiliary judgments select the same Stage 1 category.
strong_auxiliary_support.effect: Supporting evidence or review trigger only; never an automatic final category or Core override.

core_exact_agreement.default: Retain the Core agreement as provisional reference after the revised guide and calibration gates pass.
core_exact_agreement.auxiliary_rule: An adjacent Auxiliary difference creates a warning only. Strong Auxiliary support for the opposite extreme, NO versus CLEAR, reopens the cell for independent adjudicator review.

core_NO_vs_PLAUSIBLE.action: For HIGH labels, or any cell affected by revised wording, both Core reviewers first re-review blind. Remaining disagreement enters the adjudication queue. For unchanged LOW labels, the cell may enter the queue directly after guide freeze.
core_NO_vs_PLAUSIBLE.auxiliary_rule: Strong support is shown to the adjudicator only after the adjudicator records an initial blind applicability judgment.

core_PLAUSIBLE_vs_CLEAR.interpretation: Primarily a threshold/intensity calibration candidate, but semantic overlap remains possible.
core_PLAUSIBLE_vs_CLEAR.action: Apply the same blind Core re-review rule as NO versus PLAUSIBLE, then adjudicate only if disagreement remains.

core_NO_vs_CLEAR.action: Mandatory blind re-review by both Core reviewers under the frozen guide. If the severe disagreement persists, mandatory independent human adjudication with a written rule-based rationale.
core_NO_vs_CLEAR.auxiliary_rule: Auxiliary support may inform the adjudicator but may never decide the cell.

one_core_genuine_missing.action: The same missing Core reviewer completes the cell after guide freeze. If the label definition changed, the other Core reviewer also refreshes the paired judgment. No imputation is permitted.
one_core_genuine_missing.failure_to_complete: Keep unresolved and exclude from the final reference set unless a separately authorized protocol designates an independent replacement anchor.

reviewer2_R3_184_through_R3_221.placeholder_policy: All 684 placeholder values remain permanently INVALID/EXCLUDED and are never restored.
reviewer2_R3_184_through_R3_221.action: After the revised guide is human-frozen, Reviewer 2 supplies 684 new real judgments. Reviewer 1 independently refreshes the same 38 by 18 cells under the identical guide so the pair is version-comparable.

auxiliary_strong_consensus.action: Supporting evidence or a manual-review trigger only. It never produces a final category and never overrides Core agreement automatically.

auxiliary_mixed_support.action: Record as uncertainty context. Do not vote, average, or infer a final category.

AUX_R06_missing.action: Use AUX-R06 normally on valid overlap with pairwise-complete denominators. The 36 blanks remain missing; do not impute or globally downweight.

AUX_R08_extreme_distribution.action: Preserve all raw judgments and report separately. Exclude AUX-R08 from consensus counts, strong-support calculations, and vote-like adjudication summaries. It may be displayed only as a separately labeled sensitivity perspective.

adjudicator_method.reviewer: One independent human who did not supply either Core judgment for the cell.
adjudicator_method.step_1: Review text, label, frozen definition, and Stage 1 anchors blind to all prior judgments; record NO, PLAUSIBLE, or CLEAR with a concise rule-based rationale.
adjudicator_method.step_2: Then view de-identified Core judgments and eligible Auxiliary distribution, with AUX-R08 separate, and either retain or revise the initial judgment with a documented reason.

old_judgment_versioning.rule: Original judgments are immutable. New re-review judgments are stored as a separate version with guide version and timestamp.
old_judgment_versioning.affected_cells: For materially revised HIGH definitions, current disagreement cells are superseded for reference construction only after both Core reviewers re-review. Exact-agreement controls test drift; they are not automatically rewritten.
old_judgment_versioning.unaffected_cells: May remain provisional only if the definition is unchanged and calibration/control gates pass.

required: Targeted Core re-review and completion work finished
Post-re-review exact agreement, confusion matrix, severe rate, and per-label statistics reported
No HIGH label below 0.60 exact agreement on its available calibration cells
No unresolved validity or placeholder contamination
